provenance.timing_note: calibration_seconds_single_thread_relative is measured on this cloud box, one thread, cache cleared; compare relatively only. It is not a scan abandonment rate.

basis: Every result is about FITS (a calibrated chain and its scored proxy), never cards. Exit premiums and R/R through shipped estimate_rr (full-premium basis, premium = mid) except option C's anchored exits, which use estimate_rr's own arithmetic. T1-T3 = the shipped ladder spacing (T2 = 1.5x, T3 = 2.0x the T1 move) with a 10% T1 move. Calibration seconds: single thread, this cloud box, cache cleared before every calibration; relative to D only, not abandonment rates.
